text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#54321 — repeated cuda_alloc failures on pool-gamma (infer-us-west-2). Spike: 27% alloc failures over last 5m. Affected service: serving/runtime. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/54321. Auto-escalation scheduled in 3m if unacked.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Devin K (oncall).

Devin K: Acked. I'm taking ownership. Can someone dump node-level memory stats and recent logs? Is this concentrated to a single node or spread across the pool?

Maria SRE: digging in — most failures trace to gpu-12 in pool-gamma. nvidia-smi and kube logs show memory saturation and repeated `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation`.

```
$ nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.used,memory.total --format=csv
0, 15382 MiB, 16384 MiB
1, 8160 MiB, 16384 MiB
2, 16290 MiB, 16384 MiB  <-- gpu-12 equivalent
```

journalctl snippet: `Aug 03 23:42:12 gpu-12 runtime[3212]: CUDA error: out of memory while allocating 2147483648 bytes`

Devin K: thanks. Temporary mitigation: I'm disabling large-batch routing for pool-gamma and routing >1024 token requests to fallback variant `gpt-lite-2q` to reduce peak allocations. Pushing routing rule now.

```
# quick routing patch
routes:
  - match: { tokens: ">1024", pool: "pool-gamma" }
    action: route_to: "gpt-lite-2q"
```

Sam Platform: I'll cordon gpu-12 and drain pods if config changes don't stabilize within 5m. Noted there might be stuck processes holding KV-cache pages. Will check for long-running worker pids.

Maria SRE: customer impact: ~3% of inferences return 502s (cuda alloc fail) over last 10m, ~1.2k errors. Many were auto-retried; however observed tail latency increases for batch sizes >= 512. Sending status to status.redwood: `degraded` with note: retries recommended.

Devin K: I'm seeing a runaway KV-cache growth for a specific model shard — one process (pid 3421) on gpu-12 stuck in LRU flush loop and continuously growing. Attempting to kill and let scheduler reschedule.

Sam Platform: go ahead and kill it if it's unsafe. I'll prepare to evict node after the kill. Adding temporary autoshedder rule if errors cross 5% for >5m.

Devin K: killed pid 3421 (`kill -9 3421`). Freed ~4.2GB on gpu-12; cuda alloc failure rate dropped from 27% -> ~2.1% in last 3m.

Maria SRE: confirmed reductions in alloc failure metric. Metrics: `cuda_alloc_fail_rate` 2.1% (5m), `gpu_mem_util` on gpu-12 now 85%. Still monitoring for regressions.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation sent to Sam Platform (infra lead).

Anna Night: taking handoff at 00:30 UTC. Summary for night: cause = GPU memory pressure on pool-gamma from KV-cache growth on a worker; mitigations applied = routing change (large batches -> gpt-lite-2q), killed runaway process, cordon/drain prepped for gpu-12, autoshedder rule prepped if errors spike. PD acknowledged by Devin. Current status: stabilized but watch for recurrence.

Anna Night: next steps I'll monitor for 30m; if `cuda_alloc_fail_rate` > 5% for 10m, trigger full pool failover to another region and notify support to throttle new jobs. Also will update the runbook to add an explicit KV-cache leak check and an automated small-batch fallback rule.

Devin K: added incident notes to ticket PD#54321 and linked the playbook: https://go/runbooks/gpu-memory-pressure. Please annotate any customer-facing communications there.

Maria SRE: leaving a short postmortem checklist in the ticket: reproduce steps, metric dashboard links, node id (gpu-12), freed pid (3421), routing patch commit id `a1f2b3c`, times of mitigation.

Anna Night: acknowledged handoff. If anything flares, I'll page the on-call rotation and escalate to Sam. Otherwise I'll close this incident after 30m of stability and update the status page. :white_check_mark:

Devin K: thanks team. :thumbsup:
